summary: {inspector} checks whether a person using a cane can detect a drinking fountain projecting into the path.
realLife: At Winton Park, inspectors identified a fountain beside the ballfield that extended into the walkway beyond what a cane user could detect.
gates: A pedestrian route passes a projecting fixture recorded as a cane-detection hazard.
inGame: needs: the fixture position, walkway clearance and cane-detectable edge.

turns.what: The inspector checks the clear path at the new location.
turns.writesBack: The revised plan identifies the new position.

turns.what: The inspector marks the clearance needed around it.
turns.pulledBy: A proposed guard narrows the walkway.
turns.writesBack: The fixture repair returns for redesign.
